# GoodStartSocks

> Factory-direct OEM and ODM custom sock manufacturing for B2B projects.

GoodStartSocks is based in Zhuji, Zhejiang, China. The factory was established in 2010 and operates approximately 50 knitting machines. The standard starting MOQ is 500 pairs. Sample preparation is typically about 3–7 days; bulk production is typically about 30 days after sample approval. Final timing and specifications depend on the construction, materials, artwork, size breakdown, packaging and order quantity.

- [Custom Socks Manufacturer](https://www.goodstartsocks.com/) — OEM/ODM custom socks, factory capabilities, FAQ and project inquiry.
- [Products](https://www.goodstartsocks.com/products.html) — custom sock style overview for brands, teams, retail and promotional projects.
- [Customization](https://www.goodstartsocks.com/customization.html) — materials, sock heights, colours, logo methods, sizes and packaging options.
- [Custom Sock Manufacturing in Zhuji, China](https://www.goodstartsocks.com/blog-custom-sock-factory-zhuji.html) — factory profile and production planning information.

- [Sock Heights Guide](https://www.goodstartsocks.com/blog-sock-heights-custom-socks.html) — common height terminology and measurement planning.
- [Contact](https://www.goodstartsocks.com/contact.html) — project inquiry, email and WhatsApp contact options.

## Information for buyers

- Starting MOQ: 500 pairs.
- Sample lead time: about 3–7 days.
- Bulk-production guide: about 30 days after sample approval.
- Services: custom sock development, sampling, bulk production, inspection coordination and packaging discussion.
- Customizable items: sock type and height, yarn and materials, colours, jacquard logos, patterns, sizing, labels, bands, hang tags, bags and boxes.
- Quote inputs: artwork or logo, sock type, estimated quantity, size range, material preference, packaging idea, delivery destination and target date.
